description.text: Duration of Study The study of CS&T program lasts 4 years in all and is composed of two periods. The first period of teaching and the last six months is for the students’ practice. Objectives The major trains enroll students to produce quality engineers of computer software and hardware in design, development and applications.By study, students can master the fundamental theories and basic techniques of computer software and hardware; eligible to analysis, design and develop software; eligible to use, develop and maintain hardware; eligible to operate and maintain computer networks. Main Courses Please click here to download the timetable of subjects It opens only when there are over 10 applicants.

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Jiangsu University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Health certificate 6.Additional materials Additional materials may be required

requirements.text: Be in good health condition, which accords with the Health Standard for International Students stipulated by the China Education Department; Have senior high school diploma and good academic record; Have basic English language ability; Have good moral character and obey the laws and regulations of the Chinese government and regulations of the university. Respect Chinese social customs and habits.
